meta.project_name: HyperloopBERT — Stage 1: SCH Hypothesis Test (VanillaBERT vs LoopedBERT)

ml_model.description: Pre-training of VanillaBERT and LoopedBERT encoders via MLM on FineWeb-Edu (200M token budget). Iso-loss band checkpointing for compute-matched comparison.

research.description: Bias evaluation on Multi-CrowS-Pairs (English) and Indian Multilingual Bias Dataset; go/no-go decision on SCH hypothesis via paired permutation tests and effect sizes.

shared.description: Cross-stage utilities: logging, statistics, plotting, bias scoring, CSV schemas, environment loading.

config.description: Stage 1 hyper-parameters, directory paths, and training budget constants.

data_pipeline.description: JSONL streaming data generator and validation-set loader for MLM pre-training.

Codes/Stage1/config_stage1.py.purpose: Defines all Stage 1 hyper-parameters, token budgets, directory paths, and iso-band targets as module-level constants.

Codes/Stage1/train_stage1.py.purpose: MLM pre-training loop for VanillaBERT and LoopedBERT; manages gradient accumulation, OOM recovery, iso-band checkpointing, and token-marker snapshots.

Codes/Stage1/eval_bias_stage1.py.purpose: Evaluates all Stage 1 model snapshots on Multi-CrowS-Pairs and Indian Bias datasets using PLL scoring; supports resumable per-row CSV writes.

Codes/Stage1/analyze_stage1.py.purpose: Loads Stage 1 results, computes paired contrasts between VanillaBERT and LoopedBERT at primary iso-bands, runs go/no-go decision logic, and writes the paper outline.

Codes/common/architectures.py.purpose: Defines all five encoder architectures (VanillaBERT, LoopedBERT, ALBERTLoopedBERT, HyperloopBERT, EarlyMergeHyperloopBERT) plus build_model factory, MLM masking, and model introspection utilities.

Codes/common/attention.py.purpose: Custom bidirectional self-attention with FlashAttention-2 / SDPA / eager fallback chain; exports BertLayer and attention-path tracking utilities.

Codes/common/bias_metrics.py.purpose: Computes PLL and SS-PLL bias scores for sentence pairs; provides WinoBias occupational-coreference scoring and pseudo-perplexity quality screen.

Codes/common/io_schemas.py.purpose: Single source of truth for all CSV column name lists used across stages; prevents inline column definition and schema drift.

Codes/common/iso_loss.py.purpose: IsoBandTracker saves model snapshots when validation loss crosses pre-registered thresholds; compute_primary_band selects the highest band all architectures share.

Codes/common/logging_setup.py.purpose: Configures rotating-file and console logging for all pipeline scripts; idempotent per-logger name.

Codes/common/env_loader.py.purpose: Loads and resolves API keys from .env with alias mapping; provides round-robin provider key rotation; never logs secret values.

Codes/common/stats_engine.py.purpose: Statistical utilities: paired permutation test, bootstrap CI, Holm-Bonferroni correction, Cohen's d, and exploratory contrast helper.

Codes/common/plotting.py.purpose: Standardized plotting functions for iso-loss bias curves, token-budget curves, loop trajectory, Pareto fronts, and stream analyses; enforces consistent architecture colour palette.

class:Codes/common/architectures.py:Vani.name: VanillaBERT
class:Codes/common/architectures.py:Vani.purpose: Standard BERT encoder with 12 independent BertLayer instances; baseline for the SCH hypothesis test.
responsibilities: Serve as compute-matched baseline for looped variants

class:Codes/common/architectures.py:Loop.name: LoopedBERT
class:Codes/common/architectures.py:Loop.purpose: Looped encoder with begin(2) → middle(2-layer shared × 4 loops) → end(2) structure; unique=6 weights, effective_depth=12.
responsibilities: Structural constraint hypothesis: 6 unique weight sets at effective depth 12
Middle block applied iteratively 4 times for depth matching
Candidate for reduced stereotype memorisation vs VanillaBERT
